About Lerishia

Digital Design With A Growing Focus On Web And UI/UX

I create digital work that balances visual clarity, usability, and strong brand communication.

I am a digital designer focused on visual communication, digital experiences, and design systems. My work builds on a strong digital design foundation while extending into web design, UI/UX thinking, and modern creative workflows.

I use AI for ideation, exploration, production support, and workflow efficiency while keeping strategy, design thinking, and final creative judgment at the center of the work.
